text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa.
I... I gave it everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san!
Great work out there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san, you really were super fast.
I just couldn't catch up to you...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I was really happy
to be with you, Bakushin O-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so?
Which means, Flower-san—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You look up to me, don't you?!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am considerably fast.
It is only natural that you look up to me. However...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san, you have your own Flower Road!
Please Bakushin down it with all your might!!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!
choice_data_list: You beat Nishino Flower, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Of course!
I am the class representative, after all."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However, Flower-san was remarkably fast as well. To be honest, there were moments that made my heart skip a beat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I finally felt what you all refer to
as 'pressure' for the very first time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, even so, this time I managed to prove
that I'm the one who's truly amazing!"
choice_data_list: Still, there's no difference in ability.

text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, Nishino Flower is a formidable rival.
If I step away from sprint races now,
she might overtake me...
choice_data_list: Don't you want to win by an even more overwhelming margin?
Don't you want to win by an even more overwhelming margin?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, yes. That nobody can catch up to her
is exactly what makes her the Class Rep!"
choice_data_list: What I need is even more speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Speed...! Even when I'm this fast, it's still not enough!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*...!
Will my legs just not be able to stop!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aha, of course!
To keep bakushin-ing through the Senior Class as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So if I beat Flower-san with an overwhelming lead,
I can finally move on to middle distance... That's what you mean, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Then let's beat Flower-san again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "I'll go ask Flower what race she's running next!!"
choice_data_list: Aren't they aiming for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen?
I think they might be aiming for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
It's a GⅠ race at the same 1200m distance.
Especially having lost this time,
she will almost certainly be there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that so!
Then I'll enter the Takamatsunomiya Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Now, all that remains...
is to prove my speed..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
I feel like we've had a conversation like this before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Or rather than before... always?
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Oooooo!!
